senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. f. Orpah, wife of Chilion, son of Naomi, in legend identified with Harafah (II Sam. XXI, 22).
units: <cite ref="Sotah 42b:9">Sot. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>בשכר ארבע דמעות שהורידה ע׳ וכ׳</he> as a reward for four tears which O. shed, when parting with her mother-in-law she was privileged to rear four mighty men (II Sam. l. c.). Ib. <he>ע׳ שמה וכ׳</he> her real name was O., and why was she called Harafah?, v. <cite ref="E00867"><he>הֲרִיפוֹת</he></cite>. Ib. <he>הרפה שמה … ע׳</he> he real name was Harafah, and why was she called O.?, v. <cite ref="P01426"><he>עָרַף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:10">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>חזייה לע׳ וכ׳</he> he (Abishai) saw O., his (Jishbi’s) mother, spinning.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:20">Ruth R. to I, 14</cite>; a. e.
